description: This file contains implementation of various Orleans grains for transaction testing, including classes for grains with multiple states, single state, no state, and a base class for transactional grains. It also defines a serializable data class and a custom exception used in testing scenarios.

classes.name: GrainData
classes.description: Serializable data class with an integer property 'Value' used within transactional grains.

classes.name: MaxStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: Grain with maximum number of transactional states, created based on a constant for maximum transactions.

classes.name: DoubleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: Grain managing two transactional states, each represented by 'data1' and 'data2'.

classes.name: SingleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: Grain managing a single transactional state.

classes.name: MultiStateTransactionalGrainBaseClass
classes.description: Base class for transactional grains managing multiple states, providing methods for setting, adding, retrieving, and testing exception scenarios.

classes.name: AddAndThrowException
classes.description: Custom serializable exception used for testing error handling in transactional grains.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to initialize the logger when the grain is activated.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets all transactional states to a new value, logging each update.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified number to each transactional state's value, returning the updated values.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves current values from all transactional states.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Performs an add operation and then throws a test exception.

methods.name: SetAndThrow
methods.description: Performs a set operation and then throws a test exception.
